work: Provincial poor-law extracts: Massachusetts Bay 1692-3 ch. 28 ss. 8-10 and New H
heading: Province of the Massachusetts Bay, 1692-3, Chapter 28: An Act for Regulating of Townships, Choice of Town Officers, and Setting forth their Power · [Sect. 8.] … [Sect. 10.]

items.text: Relieve your poor lineal relatives (parent, grandparent, child, grandchild) if you are of sufficient ability, as the justices assess.
items.quote: then such relations respectively shall relieve such poor person

heading: Province of New Hampshire, 1719, Chapter 12: An Act for Regulating Townships, Choice of Town Officers & Setting forth their Power … [Warned persons to depart]

items.text: Relieve your father or mother if they are poor and you are able, as the justices assess.
items.quote: Such Relations respectively Shall releive Such poor person in Such manner as the Justices of the Peace Shall assess
